semiconductor_relevance: High — BJCORE is a leading manufacturer of semiconductor dicing equipment, crucial for wafer processing.
summary: BJCORE (Shenzhen) Semiconductor Co., Ltd specializes in the development and production of semiconductor dicing equipment and consumables. Their advanced dicing machines are used for precision cutting of materials like silicon wafers and ceramics, serving sectors such as IC, QFN, and LED substrates.
capabilities: Precision dicing for silicon wafers, ceramics, and PCBs
High-precision guide rails and ball screws
Advanced software functionalities for dicing equipment
technical_expertise: Advanced software integration for semiconductor equipment

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shenzhen, serving over 20 Fortune 500 companies with its semiconductor dicing equipment.
